ValidationRule.description: Checks whether the user has selected only one value or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )),
AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), OR(ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect Destination'),ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Diversion')),OR(AND(ISBLANK( PMC_SS_NewDestinationLocation__c ),ISBLANK( PMC_SS_NewDestinationShipTo__c )),
AND(NOT(ISBLANK( PMC_SS_NewDestinationLocation__c )),NOT(ISBLANK( PMC_SS_NewDestinationShipTo__c )))))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only fill either one of them, New Destination Location or New Destination Ship To
